-36.46159,146.22073: Early on the cold winter morning of Monday, June 28th 1880, the seriously wounded Edward (Ned) Kelly finally fell at this place and was captured, brought down by Sergeant Steeles double barrelled shotgun, fired from across the nearby creek.
-36.46287,146.22359: This plaque marks the place where V. R. repairers Reardon and Sullivan were forced by Ned Kelly to remove rail track in an unsuccessful attempt to wreck the police train June 27 1880
